subject: Re: KMS audit handshake — Horizon Health evidence request
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@horizonhealth.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: KMS / HSM artefacts request for SIG + SOC2 review

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier on the SIG scoping call. Horizon's security team has formally requested a small set of artifacts to complete our encryption controls review for the upcoming vendor assessment. Can you provide the following within 10 business days?

- KMS architecture diagram showing where keys are generated, stored (HSM vs managed KMS), and envelope-encryption flow.
- HSM attestation or vendor statement for any hardware-based modules in use (e.g., CloudHSM / Thales) for the last 12 months.
- Key rotation export (events) for master and principal wrapping keys for the last 12 months (CSV preferred).
- KMS access matrix / IAM roles showing who/which service identities have key-encrypt / key-decrypt privileges.
- Any BYOK (bring-your-own-key) handshake notes or documented process if applicable.
- Short summary of in-transit and at-rest encryption controls and where TLS termination occurs.

We can accept uploads to a secure bucket link or a shared Drive folder. Attached is a short scope PDF and a timeline template to populate delivery dates.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Security Manager — Horizon Health
[Attachment: horizon_sig_scope.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]
[Attachment: timeline_template.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)]

From: rachel.kim@redwood.com
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS / HSM artefacts request for SIG + SOC2 review

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list and the scope PDF. We can provide all of the items you requested. High-level plan:

- I will own the artifact delivery and will upload to a secure, time-bound link.
- Neha (cc) will pull the rotation export and HSM attestation.
- Monica (cc) will prepare the access matrix and BYOK notes.
- Stephanie (cc) from our account team will coordinate any procurement/NDAs if required.

Proposed delivery: 2027-04-30 (8 business days). If that works, we'll populate the timeline_template and start a secure upload. Can you confirm whether you need redaction for any PII in the logs?

We'll attach an evidence index file so you can track what's been delivered.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_evidence_index.csv (CSV, 3KB)]

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: KMS / HSM artefacts request — evidence list and extraction notes

Folks — quick internal note on the artifacts I'm pulling / how we'll format them:

1) KMS architecture diagram: updated diagram attached (will upload PNG/PDF to secure folder). It will show envelope encryption: model weights and inference payloads use envelope keys; master wrapping keys in AWS CloudHSM.
2) HSM attestation: we have the CloudHSM vendor attestation PDF for 2026 (attached stub). If Horizon needs KCVs or certificate chains, we'll pull those from the HSM vendor portal.
3) Rotation export: CSV with event timestamps, key id, rotation type (auto/manual), actor (service principal or RH user id). I've scheduled a DB export covering 2026-04-01 through 2027-03-31.
4) Access matrix: will be an IAM-role-to-key mapping and will include service principals used by hosted API; Monica will draft a simplified matrix for Horizon.

Action items: Monica to generate access_matrix_v1.csv and put both rotation CSV and attestation PDF into the secure upload. Rachel to approve prior to upload.

[Attachment: kms_rotation_export_2026-04-01_2027-03-31.csv (CSV, 42KB)]
[Attachment: hsm_attestation_aws_cloudhsm_2026.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

- Neha

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@horizonhealth.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: samir@tech-audit.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS / HSM artefacts request for SIG + SOC2 review

Thanks Rachel and team — that plan looks good and 2027-04-30 meets our timeline. Two quick clarifications before upload:

1) Please ensure rotation exports include the authz actor identifier (service principal id or user id) and timezone-normalized timestamps (UTC).
2) We prefer a read-only signed-upload link with a 30-day expiry. If you could include checksums for the CSVs that would be great.

If you prefer, Samir from TechAudit (cc) can accept the upload link and bring it directly into our assessment tracker.

Elena
Security Manager — Horizon Health
[Preferred upload: https://secure-upload.redwood.com/horizon/abc123]
